chunks: They alone are believers who come to believe in God and His Apostle, then never doubt again, and struggle wealth and soul in the way of God. They are the truthful and sincere.
ai.seo_question: What are the three main characteristics that define a true believer according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah At-Tawbah is often linked with Surah Al-Hujurat (49:15) to distinguish between mere nominal belief and the complete submission (islam) characterized by the absence of internal doubt (irtibab). The emphasis on 'wealth and selves' highlights the dual dimensions of jihad, while the title 'al-sadiqun' underscores the integrity of their inner conviction matching their outer actions, a key concept in Shia spiritual ethics.
